scope: Independent actual original-resolution review of all88 newly captured detail/wheel PNGs for final44 metadata. Bounded website presentation only; not source-model reacceptance, physicalGPU, target scene, proof-cache trust, fullCI or live publication acceptance.
nonblocking_visual_caveat: Very low alpha floor-shadow RGB can appear as rainbow/mesh halos in raw image viewers. Actual catalog-background composites were independently inspected for Baiera, Mudpot and Parvancorina and show faint neutral shadows. Original PNG bytes are not edited, and no opaque geometry fragments were found.
